Smart TV & Streaming Setup Logan. No Frustration, No Delays.

We ensure your TVs, sound systems, streaming apps and smart assistants are set up correctly and ready to go, whether it's Netflix, Disney+, Stan, Kayo, Binge, or Free-to-Air apps like ABC iView, SBS On Demand, 7Plus, 9Now and 10Play.

🛡️

Insurance & Warranty Guidance

General guidance on home and contents coverage for your new TV.

Who We Serve

Home, Business & Outdoor Entertainment.

Families, gamers, movie lovers and streaming enthusiasts at home. Small businesses, offices, cafés, gyms, waiting areas and conference rooms. Multi-room and outdoor entertainment setups for pools and patios. And smart home users after voice control and assistant integration.

  • Streaming plan advice. Which service suits your household or business.
  • TV placement tips. Optimal viewing distance and height.
  • Network optimisation. Reduce buffering by prioritising devices.
  • Child-safe viewing guides. Managing parental controls and profiles.
  • Accessibility guide. Captions, audio description and larger fonts for public spaces.
Why Choose Computer Repairs Logan

All Major Brands, Same-Day Service.

  • All major brands. Samsung, LG, Sony, Hisense, TCL, Panasonic and more.
  • Same-day or next-day service. Depending on availability.
  • Friendly, jargon-free instructions. Explained in plain English.
  • Homes and small businesses. Both fully supported.
  • Follow-up help. Troubleshooting whenever you need it.
  • Experienced technicians. Across Logan & South East Queensland.
Set Up My Smart TV
Related Services

Building Out Your Home Entertainment Setup?

Buffering during peak times? A stronger network makes the biggest difference, see our network optimisation & WiFi mesh design service. Turning your own movies and shows into a home library at the same time? Check out our Plex & media server setup. Want to keep the kids' viewing in check across every screen, not just the TV? See our family safety & screen time solutions. Adding security cameras to the same visit? We also do CCTV & security camera installation.

Frequently Asked Questions

Smart TV & Streaming Setup Questions, Answered.

Do you install all brands of Smart TVs?

Yes, we install and configure all major brands including Samsung, LG, Sony, Hisense, TCL, Panasonic and more.

Can you wall mount my Smart TV?

Absolutely. We provide professional wall mounting with secure brackets and tidy cable management.

Can you help if my TV is buffering or apps are crashing?

Definitely. We optimise your WiFi, update apps, and adjust settings to ensure smooth streaming.

Do you set up parental controls for kids?

Yes. We can create safe profiles, set PIN codes, and restrict content based on age ratings.

Can you connect my TV to Alexa, Google Assistant or Siri?

Absolutely. We integrate Smart TVs with your preferred voice assistant for hands-free control.

Do you offer multi-room or multi-TV setups?

Yes, we can link multiple TVs in your home or business so streaming is seamless across rooms.

Do you integrate soundbars or home theatre systems?

Yes, we configure all audio systems, including surround sound, for optimal performance and sync.

Do you connect gaming consoles to Smart TVs?

Yes, Xbox, PlayStation, Nintendo and other gaming systems are fully integrated for gaming and streaming.

Do you support older TVs with streaming devices like Chromecast or Apple TV?

Yes, we can set up streaming devices for older TVs to enable Netflix, Disney+ and other apps.

Can you configure a universal remote?

Yes, we can program one remote to control your TV, soundbar and streaming devices.

Ready For A TV Setup That Just Works?

Same-day or next-day appointments across Logan, depending on availability.
